question: The distance between points A and B is 933 km. Namit travels from A to B at a speed of 70 km/hr and returns at a speed of 111 km/hr. Calculate Namit’s average speed for the entire journey (rounded off to two decimal places).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed (equal distance) = 2ab / (a + b)

= (2 × 70 × 111) / (70 + 111)

= 15540 / 181 ≈ 85.86 km/hr

**∴ Answer ≈ 85.86 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance one way = 933 km

Speed onward = 70 km/hr, return = 111 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time forward = 933 / 70 = 13.33 hr

⇒ Time return = 933 / 111 = 8.41 hr

⇒ Total distance = 1866 km

⇒ Total time ≈ 21.74 hr

⇒ Average speed = 1866 ÷ 21.74 ≈ 85.86 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer ≈ 85.86 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Important Rule

For equal distances, average speed = 2ab / (a + b)

Common Mistake

Do not take simple average of speeds.

Tip

Use shortcut formula to save time.
